require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
prior=File.expand_path('../invariant-selector-candidate-2026-10-30',o)
bin=prior+'/candidate-kujo';probe=prior+'/task-allocation-probe'
accept=JSON.parse(File.read(prior+'/acceptance-receipt.json'));raise 'Baseline unaccepted' unless accept['status']=='accepted'
accept['evidence_hashes'].each{|p,h|raise 'Accepted evidence drift' unless sha.call(prior+'/'+p)==h}
input='benchmarks/langarena/remaining-capture-baseline-2026-10-30.json';b=JSON.parse(File.read(input))
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,runtime:'f1893ea',identities:[bin,probe,input,__FILE__].to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]},sources:{},rows:[],semantics:[]}
raise 'Existing output' if File.exist?(o+'/report.json')
save=->{File.write(o+'/report.json.tmp',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n");File.rename(o+'/report.json.tmp',o+'/report.json')};save.call
begin
 b['observations'].each do |name,report|
  resolve=->(old) do
   root=File.expand_path('../remaining-capture-2026-10-30/'+name,o)
   if name=='retained-local'
    folder=root+'/bindings-'+old['bindings'].to_s
    [folder+"/#{old['operation']}-#{old['calls']}.kujo",folder+'/local_state.kujo',"LOCAL CAPTURE PASS\n"]
   else
    folder=root+"/captured-read-fixtures/#{old['kind']}-#{old['bindings']}-#{old['width']}"
    [folder+"/calls-#{old['calls']}.kujo",folder+'/read_state.kujo',"CAPTURED READ PASS\n"]
   end
  end
  %w[rows semantics].each do |category|
   report[category].each_with_index do |old,index|
    path,mod,expected=resolve.call(old)
    [[path,old['source_sha256']],[mod,old['module_sha256']]].each{|p,h|raise 'Fixture drift' unless sha.call(p)==h;r[:sources][p]=h}
    argv=category=='rows' ? [probe,old['mode'],path] : [bin,'run',path]+(old['mode']=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+old['mode']])
    stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*argv);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout==expected
    current={argv:argv,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus}
    if category=='rows'
     m=stderr.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise 'Missing counts' unless m
     current[:requests]=m[1].to_i;current[:bytes]=m[2].to_i
    end
    r[category.to_sym]<<{report:name,index:index,baseline:old,current:current};save.call if r[category.to_sym].size%8==0
   end
  end
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==80&&r[:semantics].size==120
 r[:identities].merge(r[:sources]).each{|p,h|raise 'Identity drift' unless sha.call(p)==h}
 r[:status]='measured';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/report.json'));raise 'Incomplete' unless r['status']=='measured'
b=JSON.parse(File.read('benchmarks/langarena/remaining-capture-baseline-2026-10-30.json'))
r['identities'].merge(r['sources']).each{|p,h|raise 'Drift' unless sha.call(p)==h}
raise 'Coverage' unless [r['rows'].size,r['semantics'].size]==[80,120]
%w[rows semantics].each do |category|
 expected=b['observations'].flat_map{|name,report|report[category].each_with_index.map{|row,i|[name,i,row]}}
 raise 'Exact coverage' unless r[category].map{|x|x.values_at('report','index','baseline')}==expected
 r[category].each do |x|
  n=x['current'];old=x['baseline'];path=n['argv'].last
  path=n['argv'][2] if category=='semantics'
  binary=File.expand_path('../invariant-selector-candidate-2026-10-30/'+(category=='rows' ? 'task-allocation-probe' : 'candidate-kujo'),o)
  argv=category=='rows' ? [binary,old['mode'],path] : [binary,'run',path]+(old['mode']=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+old['mode']])
  raise 'Invocation' unless n['argv']==argv
  raise 'Source hash' unless sha.call(path)==old['source_sha256']
  expected_stdout=x['report']=='retained-local' ? "LOCAL CAPTURE PASS\n" : "CAPTURED READ PASS\n"
  raise 'Output' unless n['exit']==0&&n['stdout']==expected_stdout
  if category=='rows'
   raise 'Mode' unless n['argv'][1]==old['mode']
   raise 'Counters' unless n['stderr'].scan(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)==[[n['requests'].to_s,n['bytes'].to_s]]
  end
 end
end
slopes=r['rows'].group_by{|x|[x['report']]+x['baseline'].values_at('bindings','operation','kind','width','mode')}.map do |group,rows|
 a,z=rows.sort_by{|x|x['baseline']['calls']}.last(2);delta=z['baseline']['calls']-a['baseline']['calls'];raise 'Interval' unless delta>0
 {group:group,bytes_before:(z['baseline']['bytes']-a['baseline']['bytes']).fdiv(delta),bytes_now:(z['current']['bytes']-a['current']['bytes']).fdiv(delta),requests_before:(z['baseline']['requests']-a['baseline']['requests']).fdiv(delta),requests_now:(z['current']['requests']-a['current']['requests']).fdiv(delta)}
end
regressions=slopes.select{|x|x[:bytes_now]>x[:bytes_before]||x[:requests_now]>x[:requests_before]}
File.write(o+'/verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate({status:regressions.empty? ? 'passed' : 'regression',allocation_observations:80,semantic_runs:120,slopes:slopes,regressions:regressions,report_sha256:sha.call(o+'/report.json'),verifier_sha256:sha.call(__FILE__),limits:'Existing retained-local and imported-read shapes only; exceptional fallback and broader materialization remain unmeasured.'})+"\n")
abort 'Capture slope regression' unless regressions.empty?
puts '80 capture observations and120semantic checks verified; no allocation slope regression.'
